title: Settle an invoice
requirements:
## R1 · event · risk: money
WHEN an invoice is settled THE SYSTEM SHALL record the payment in the ledger and then mark the invoice paid.

## R2 · unwanted · risk: money
IF the ledger write fails THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the invoice unpaid and report the failure to the caller.
